operation: Read-only Win32_Process name, parent, creation date, GetOwner and command-match checks. Raw command lines and security tokens were not recorded.
lifecycle: Reader left running for operator review. Reverify saved process identity, creation time, command and descendants before an operator-authorized stop using taskkill /PID 5280 /T /F. Do not select a process solely by port or reused PID.
listenerQualification: No new independent LISTENING-row proof; the previously accepted OS listener-enumeration limitation remains.
